Le casque de l'arcaniste ne semble pas s'accorder avec sa tenue, on dirait que sa tête est 2 fois plus grosse c'est bizarre (et moche) Aussi de facon générale j'ai l'impression que la nuque est super longue.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: separate full HEADLESS armor outfit body for a 64x64 cyberpunk roguelike.
Reference role: class anatomy, augmentation identity, relaxed frontal pose, proportions and rendering. Replace the worn clothing with this new armor model.
Draw ONE body from the BASE OF THE JAW/SHORT ANATOMICAL NECK to BOTH SOLES. NO head, face, hair, headgear, helmet or hood. NO tall neck tube, long neck cylinder, stalk, raised mannequin peg or pedestal. The collar opening sits directly between the shoulders; neck projection above shoulders is tiny.
Straight-front balanced stance; both arms relaxed down with a little gap, two EMPTY hands visible, ordinary human limb counts, all toes/soles inside the image. No weapons, tools, extra limbs, backpack projections or effects.
The torso armor supplies the whole outfit: upper body, arms, gloves, pants/skirt, legs and boots. Protection must visibly increase with the requested tier.
Native body height is about 48-52 pixels: use very few large matte faceted masses, 2-3 broad tones, clear continuous dark contour and simple upper-left lighting. No microtexture, rivets, tiny straps, thin dangling parts or noisy panels. Useful large material areas should separate from a medium-dark floor.
Genuinely transparent background around the whole isolated character body, generous margins, no halo, vignette, ground or cast shadow. No labels, symbols or text.

CLASS:
A machine priest: an almost entirely mechanical adult figure, no flesh. DARK sober work-vestments, plain charcoal/ash-grey cloth, aged copper chassis and gauntlets. Long narrow slit robes, simple asymmetrical drape and a few large functional guards. Not turquoise, not a colorful wizard, no long pointed fantasy hood, ornate trim, robe patterns or square white marine armor. Dark cloth still has broad medium-grey planes and pale ash edge/lining for native64 visibility; articulated copper hands and lower legs remain readable.
MODEL:
VERY LIGHT: plain knee-length charcoal technician tabard over an exposed dark robotic torso core, minimal ash-grey cloth edge, uncovered copper mechanical upper/forearms with light hand guards. Thin robotic thighs and calves, practical narrow mechanical boots. Small shoulder cloth fold, no large body plates.
